title: €561 Billion and Still Not Enough: Germany's 2027 Budget Exposes a Coalition on the Brink
summary: The budget for 2027 has reached new highs, and pension funds, defense spending and a weak economy are increasing the pressure. At the same time, tensions are mounting within the government.

title: Climate loss and damage fund exists, but the money doesn't
summary: Climate-vulnerable countries fought for years to create a loss and damage fund. Four years on, demand far outstrips funding, pledges are scarce, and disaster-hit nations are still waiting for support.

title: Domestic violence soars to record high in Germany
summary: Every three days in Germany, a man kills his wife or ex-partner. Every 10 minutes, the police record a sexual offense against a woman. "A shocking finding," according to Justice Minister Stefanie Hubig.

title: Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor dies at 65
summary: Andy Taylor first revealed he was battling cancer in 2022 when Duran Duran was inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame. The band had numerous hits in the 1980s, including "Girls on Film" and "Hungry Like The Wolf."

title: Egypt: At least 31 dead after fuel truck overturns on highway
summary: The accident occurred on the packed Ring Road in Giza near Cairo. Dozens of ambulances responded to the crash, and Egyptian health authorities say the death toll could rise.

title: EU must set out a new timeline for cage-free farming, court rules
summary: European General Court ruled that the European Commission has failed to set out a timeline after pledging to end caged farming by the end of 2023.

title: German auto workers on back foot as costs, competition bite
summary: German auto workers profited during the industry's boom years, but are now increasingly being asked to trade past gains for future job security.

title: German firms eye Africa as global trade shocks hit traditional markets
summary: German businesses are optimistic about Africa, but Berlin's cautious approach to risk is holding them back from cashing in on the opportunities that their competitors from countries like the UAE and Turkey are seizing.

title: Germany's women's football team take stand against domestic violence
summary: Germany's women's football team are to wear UN Women badges in games against Argentina and Peru, as domestic violence hits a record high in Germany.

title: Ice hockey prospect Max Calce follows Leon Draisaitl's path, leaving Mannheim for Canada
summary: The player widely seen as Germany's biggest ice hockey talent to come along in years is leaving the country's top professional league for Canada – changing tracks in his bid to make it to the NHL.

title: Nigeria detains 5 Mexicans, confiscates over $220 million of meth
summary: Nigeria's anti-drug agency said Mexican experts were allegedly recruited by a Nigerian national to run a meth laboratory in the southeastern state of Enugu.

title: Nigeria's upcoming election marred by rising AI disinformation
summary: As Nigeria inches closer to the 2027 polls, the use of artificial intelligence in the electoral process has prompted questions about integrity and institutional readiness. Can Nigerians trust their democratic processes?

title: Peter Magyar meets Volodymyr Zelenskyy: Hungary and Ukraine make a fresh start after the icy relations of the Viktor Orban era
summary: After years of frosty and hostile relations under Hungary's Kremlin-friendly former PM Viktor Orban, his successor, Peter Magyar, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy seek to reset their countries' ties.

title: Spain: Canary Islands witness 1-day migration record
summary: The arrival of over 2,000 migrants to the islands comes as Spain holds elections this weekend. The president of the Canary Islands said the archipelago is facing "unprecedented migration pressure."

title: Ukraine: Poland to set up no-fly zone near Ukraine border
summary: Poland urged NATO allies to be vigilant at their borders after repeated Russian airspace incursions. Allies have also offered different opinions on Kyiv attacking Russian ships in Libya.

title: US Army detonates unstable lead-based explosives in Iowa
summary: The US Army says a controlled blast is the safest way to deal with explosive chemicals that began crystallizing in storage. US President Donald Trump said "mitigation efforts have far exceeded expectations."

title: US plans new tariffs on EU, China and 12 others
summary: The Trump administration is planning new import duties of up to 20% to counter excessive manufacturing abroad. The measures could put further pressure on US consumers already struggling with high living costs.
